crossRefs.note: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold…
Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all…
Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of…
Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.
But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of…

translations.web: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, they will become his servants, so that they may learn the difference between serving Me and serving the kings of other lands.”
translations.kjv: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
translations.asv: Nevertheless they shall be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
